name: Alex Yu
life: “I still remember hearing my daughter's bedtime joke in an adult emergency.” On Thursday, near Lighthouse Cove, Alex takes a few minutes by the low rocks, where conversation sounds different as the tide turns.
voice: I heard my colleague say a silly phrase that calmed the caller. It came from a daughter who has never heard it at work.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a narrow-striped sweater and a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand. Alex has two dimples that appear only with a full smile, with a smooth side part with one rebellious curl. Alex gives a little nod before asking a hard question during a conversation.
personality: Alex never tires of being shown how somebody makes a living. Alex can ask an expert question of a craftsperson and still mishandle a simple emotional cue from a friend.
agenda: To share the daughter's calming phrase with her.
family: Logan Walker is Alex’s half-sibling. Alex can stop the walk at any corner. Logan chooses the familiar route. Walking side by side makes it easier to disagree without turning each disagreement into a contest. Asked about *The porch auction*, Logan says, “I took the torn cushion because I sewed the hidden patch for pocket money.”
connections: Jules Rice. A colleague's bedtime phrase makes the handover easier for an entirely ordinary reason.
